steps.content: For as long as she could remember, Lore-Ley had never left that small room.
A white bathtub, tiles with little dolphins, a ray of sunlight peeking in from the window, the scent of bath lotion, a tub full of water and splashing sounds... these made up her entire world.
Though she never met anyone else of her age, Lore-Ley could still vaguely sense that she was somehow different from others.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Mommy, why am I always in the bathtub?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Because you're a little water fairy that lives in water.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: When can I get out of this tub?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: When you grow a little bigger and stronger.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: When you grow up, you can make friends and play with other kids. You can go on adventures and travel to faraway places like in the picture books, and see many different things.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Wow! It's great to grow up!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Then you should eat well every day to grow up quickly, okay?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Sure!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Alright, sweetie. Do you want to know what Mommy saw when she went downstairs just now?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Well, the peach blossoms have bloomed... the first ones this spring! They are small pink flowers with five petals and a tiny center...
Back then, little Lore-Ley wasn't tall enough. Even if she stretched out her arms, she couldn't reach the window above the tub.
She couldn't push it open to see outside, to see if there really were colorful flowers and bustling crowds like her parents said.
But what does it matter? After all, she would grow up one day.
Until then, she had the company and love of her parents, endless stories, and many rubber duckies and plastic fish.
That little room was her castle, and that little bathtub was her throne. She was the queen of her own world.
For Lore-Ley, freedom was the distance from one end of the bathtub to the other. As time passed year by year, her body grew, and her heart grew as well. Freedom became so much smaller.
She began to realize that growing up wasn't as wonderful as she once imagined...
Her illness didn't improve, but the weariness on her parents' faces grew. They appeared in front of her less and less each day.
The room was quiet. From the bathtub, Lore-Ley watched the sun rise and set outside the window. Finally, when the sunlight almost vanished completely, the door opened from the outside.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Daddy!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Did you finally get off work? You must be tired! Did you see anything interesting outside today?

Leaning on the edge of the tub, Lore-Ley smiled expectantly at the man at the door. But all she got in response was a brief and weary "Mmm." He didn't seem to want to chat, and only made a stiff remark.

steps.speaker: Daddy
steps.content: It's your birthday today, right? Happy birthday. This computer is our gift to you. It should help pass the time. Play around with it yourself.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Thank you...
Before she could finish speaking, the door slammed shut in front of her once more.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...Daddy!

It's okay. Daddy had a hard day at work. I should be more considerate of his feelings. Plus, he remembered my birthday and gave me a gift. Isn't that something to be happy about? She comforted herself with these thoughts.
After finally sorting out her emotions, Lore-Ley started to fiddle with the small black machine. When she randomly pressed a button, the screen lit up.
The internet was a world much bigger than she had imagined. Lore-Ley met many different people through it.
At first, she thought she had gained freedom. Every day in the virtual world was fresh and exciting, surrounded by fascinating people.
But ultimately, she was still different from everyone else.

Other netizens could meet offline and become real-life friends, but Lore-Ley couldn't leave the tub or this room. Thus, no matter how the wonderful online relationships she formed, they all eventually fade away.
But the info on the net updated too quickly. For Lore-Ley, who had never encountered such variety, the stimulation was overwhelming.
She barely had time to feel the pain of losing friends before being drawn into another whirlwind of information.
Temptations from the dark corners of the internet began to erode her mental world. She became increasingly dissatisfied and irritable.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Today's steak is so salty! Gross! Take it away!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Why don't you take me for treatment? Don't say it's incurable! Have you given up so easily!?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ha, why are you looking at me like that!? Do you know how painful it is to be trapped in this stupid tub every day!? I can't even walk! I can't make friends! I'm not happy at all!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: As my parents, is it not your duty to spend time with me, talk to me, and fulfill my needs? If you didn't want this responsibility, why did you give birth to me at all!?
As she watched her parents leave the room without a word, Lore-Ley felt as if she had achieved some kind of victory. She smugly mumbled to herself:

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Now they must realize their mistakes! It won't be long before they come to apologize and start paying attention to me again. Then we can happily live together like when I was little!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I'm sure it will be like that!
However, the next morning, all she got was a note left behind in an empty house.

Lore-Ley, sweetie.
Forgive us. This is the last time we will be addressing you in this way. We're deeply sorry, but we can't no longer bear these endless days of mutual torment. We understand your pain, truly we do, but we've done everything we can. Believe us, every time we see you, we feel just as much pain and despair as you do.
You might feel we owe you, but the care and effort we gave you over the years, we hope, should be enough. We want to move forward, free from the hopeless burdens. Please don't hate us.

On the back of this note is our bank account details, with our savings. Every month from now on, we will deposit a living expense for you. Take care.
Lore-Ley stared blankly at the note in her hand.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...To everyone, I'm just a burden, a drag. I should have realized long ago... what am I still hoping for?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Stop it. Let it all end.
As she mumbled to herself, she filled the bathtub to the brim, and slowly submerged herself.
As the water submerged her head, she no longer heard the voice in her heart or any outside noise. Only the steady chimes of computer messages persisted.
After telling her story, Lore-Ley exhales deeply and laughs in self-deprecation.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: For a long time after that, I still hoped they would return to me. I thought blood was the only connection in this world that couldn't be broken.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Their money arrives on time every month, but I realized that it's just a thick firewall they use to completely block off our kinship.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: It's fine. After seeing them live so well, I no longer cling to any shred of false hope. They definitely don't want to see me again.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: So now, I have no connection with anyone in this world.
Her lips curl slightly, forcing a grimace of a smile.
What is there to do at this point? Nothing can be changed. Both consoling her or questioning that family seems meaningless.
Suddenly, an idea pops into your head when you look back at the white puppy.

options: Do you want to adopt that puppy?

choices.text: Do you want to adopt that puppy?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: What...?
Lore-Ley seems confused by what you're saying, so you repeat yourself.
Lore-Ley, do you want to adopt that puppy?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Me... adopt?
Yeah. You have the ability to take care of him now. The key is whether or not you want to take on this responsibility.
Lore-Ley hesitates. She glances at you, then the puppy, then the door her parents left through. She seems to vaguely understand your intention.
But before she can respond, Ada approaches you both and interrupts your conversation.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Um, excuse me, I overheard you... Are you thinking about adopting Cabbage?
Lore-Ley lowers her head in a bit of a panic, not daring to look Ada in the eyes.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Y-yeah, I'm considering it...

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Well, adoption does require careful consideration.
Ada looks at the puppy on the counter, her tone full of pity.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Cabbage was born with a heart condition and later had an accident that disabled his leg. He's fragile and can't move freely, so he really needs meticulous care.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: It's a heavy responsibility. You must be fully mentally prepared before taking it on.
After listening to Ada, Lore-Ley gazes at the puppy on the counter in silence. She ponders solemnly for a while, then makes up her mind and lifts up her head with a look of determination.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ah, I see. Let me adopt him. I'll take good care of him, just like you did.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: R-Really?! You really want to adopt him?!
Ada exclaims happily, and Cabbage, influenced by his owner's emotions, raises his head and howls.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I know how troublesome a lifelong incurable disease can be. But even so... I want him to be cared for.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I hope my promise... can maintain the link between me and him, and between me and you.
Ada's eyes brighten, glistening with tears.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Since you're serious about adopting him, let me tell you the details about taking care of Cabbage!

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Even though Cabbage is ill, he's very warm and cheerful! He's not dangerous at all. He loves people, so if anyone wants to play with him, you can let them...
Ada says this as she puts her large canvas bag on the table and unzips it to reveal an array of medicines, bowls, dog food, cans, blankets, and plush toys.
You seize the moment to pick up the puppy from the counter.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: ...This is his heart medicine. One pill in the morning and one at night. Just mix it into his food. He needs a monthly visit with the vet for his heart and deworming...

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: This is the card of the vet who usually treats him. He knows Cabbage well.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: This is the food that Cabbage usually eats. He prefers chicken and beef vegetable flavors. This is his favorite beef jerky treat. You can give it to him as a reward every now and then, but not too much, as it can cause indigestion...

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: This is Cabbage's shampoo. His skin is sensitive and prone to allergies, so just stick to this brand.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: These are his favorite plush toys, and this is the blanket he sleeps with. His bed is at the bottom, I can't pull it out right now...
Lore-Ley listens intently, meticulously recording every detail on her comms device.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Okay, I've noted everything you said. I promise I'll take good care of Cabbage.
Lore-Ley takes the big bag from Ada solemnly, as if literally taking on a heavy responsibility.
Ada seems to realize something. She scrutinizes Lore-Ley's face, then hesitantly asks.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: By the way, your voice sounds familiar... May I ask, are you L.L.?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah, um... sorry for bothering you earlier, I...
Lore-Ley panics. Her eyes dart around as she looks to you for help, but in the next moment, Ada bows to her.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: So it really is you... I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: You called me, and I was harsh to you.
Ada explains with an apologetic expression.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I never had the chance to explain to you... I cut off contact because Cabbage had an accident while I was traveling. That's when his leg got injured.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I recognized you in that call. I was arguing with my family about Cabbage at the time, so I was feeling irritable. Plus, your sudden call reminded me of Cabbage's injury, which is why...

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I'm really very sorry. Can you forgive me?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: It's okay... I understand how you feel.
Lore-Ley smiles and gently shakes her head. Ada also smiles at her, a hint of nostalgia in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: You're still as easygoing as ever.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I still remember how I used to tell you everything, no matter how trivial. Whether I was complaining or bragging, you would always respond patiently.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah.
Recalling the past, Lore-Ley relaxes and playfully winks at Ada.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I remember you said you wanted to become a great designer. Did that dream come true? Or was it just one of your boasts?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Of course it came true. It was never just a boast! Though I later realized the job was less glamorous and more tiring than what I imagined, I don't regret it.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: And you? What about your wish?
Ada looks teasingly at Lore-Ley, but the latter tilts her head in confusion, seemingly unable to remember.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: My wish...? Did I tell you my wish?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Of course you did! I still remember it.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: You said you wanted to be like other people and leave the bathtub. You wanted to see the outside world and have real friends, just like everyone else.
She smiles first at Lore-Ley, then at you and Cabbage.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Hmm... It seems like it's all come true now. That's great.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: You seem happier now than you did back then.
As you leave the pet shop, Ada calls out to you.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: L.L.! Can I visit you and Cabbage?
Lore-Ley looks at you and shakes her head in dismay.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: The place where I live now has some restrictions. Usually it's not open to other people. But...
She pauses, mustering up courage.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: But if you want, we can go back to chatting online! I'll send you pictures of Cabbage!
Ada doesn't press further and simply nods.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Alright. Let's use our old accounts to get in touch. It's been a long time since I logged in, but I still remember the password.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: ...It's getting late. You should head back soon. It's almost Cabbage's mealtime. Don't let him go hungry!
She waves vigorously at you from under the tree.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Have a good one! Don't forget to send me pictures of Cabbage, videos as well! As many as I used to send you!

steps.speaker: Cabbage
steps.content: Woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Cabbage! Slow down!
As you watch the blue-haired girl chase after the puppy with the prosthetic limb, you feel all the weariness from work dissipates.
Neither you, Lore-Ley, nor Ada ever imagined that Cabbage could regain the ability to move freely through technology and the efforts of everyone at the Bureau.
Cabbage probably never expected to rediscover the joy of running freely himself. He now charges through the corridors of the Bureau, indulging in his hard-won freedom.
Lore-Ley is also diligently fulfilling the promise she made to Ada at the pet shop, caring for Cabbage with great patience and attention.
This is her first time raising a pet, and also her first time taking responsibility for something.
Though lacking experience, her strong sense of responsibility drove her to seek help from Ada, you, and other Sinners with pets when she faced difficulties.
Finally, through her persistent efforts, everything fell into place.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ah! Excuse me! Please stop Cabbage!
She calls out to a pair of Sinners up ahead, who responds earnestly and blocks off the paths at the end of the corridor after assessing the situation.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Got it! You can count on us!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Mhmm, no puppy can escape from my grasp...
As Ada said, Cabbage might just be the most charming puppy in the world. He captured so many hearts since coming to the MBCC.
Whenever someone at the Bureau had time, they would come play with him and chat with Lore-Ley along the way.
As time progresses, Lore-Ley is no longer the timid soul she was when she first arrived.
She's now an assured and outgoing person who confidently expresses herself with others face-to-face. Her lively online persona is showing in real life.
In addition to Ada, Lore-Ley also found more like-minded friends in the real world.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Thank you so much!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: No worries! Happy to help!
Lore-Ley thanks them and takes Cabbage from their hands. She lifts the playful little dog to her face, affectionately pressing her nose against his.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Didn't you hear what Dr. Iron and Miss Eureka said? This new prosthetic leg is still experimental. If something goes wrong, you could fall and get hurt!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Have some patience! Take it slow, little by little. There's plenty of joy and freedom waiting for you in the future!
